name: event-indexed-emission-matrix
solidity: pragma solidity >=0.8.0;contract EventProbe{event Simple(uint256 x);event TwoIndexed(address indexed who,uint256 indexed val,string note);event ThreeIndexed(address indexed a,bytes32 indexed b,uint256 indexed c,string payload);event IndexedString(string indexed tag,uint256 v);function emitMany(string calldata tag,uint256 v)external{emit Simple(v);emit TwoIndexed(msg.sender,v,tag);emit IndexedString(tag,v);emit ThreeIndexed(msg.sender,keccak256(bytes(tag)),v,tag);emit Simple(v+1);}function emitDupes(uint256 n)external{for(uint256 i=0;i<n;i++){emit Simple(i);emit Simple(i);}}}

args: a much longer tag string to exercise dynamic indexed hashing
